item.title: Empress Amber I Crowned
item.description: On January 4th, Pavian citizenry from across all classes gathered to usher in a new era for the Empire, with the coronation of Pavia’s first Empress, Amber I of House Solberg.

item.title: Unconstitutional?
item.description: On Monday morning, just half a day after the election results were announced, Prime Minister Gobblin presented his first official act at a press conference.

item.title: Gobblin Gobbles Prime Ministership
item.description: In what came as a shock result to some, the UPP received a nearly immediate win in the first round of voting with 14 votes, leading to a 15 vote win in the second round.

item.title: Prime Minister Resigns
item.description: In a surprising turn of events, Cissonius has today announced his immediate resignation from the post of Prime Minister, a development that has surprised many political pundits and the reasoning is nothing short of curious.

item.title: PM Betrayal Plunges Country Into Chaos
item.description: After the cabinet under Prime Minister Cissonius launched tax and immigration reforms at the beginning of the week, he has now cancelled the governing coalition with Renew.

item.title: Sixteen Hospitalised In Latest Street Unrests
item.description: Sixteen Pavians, of whom five currently in critical condition, were admitted to the Pavian Hospital of the Well-Heeled last night as a result of a violent confrontation among widespread unrest in the city.

item.title: Fanatical Tax and Immigration Reform Passed Tonight
item.description: In an unexpected announcement, Prime Minister Cissonius has launched two new decrees.
